body.statement: If the ordinary \(\operatorname{ID}\) algorithm fails while processing \(P(Y=y\mid\operatorname{do}(X=x))\) in an ADMG \(\mathcal G\), then that causal effect is not identifiable from \(P(V)\) in \(\mathcal G\).

attestation.note: The failure-to-nonidentification implication was checked against Theorem 18 in the cited JMLR article.
